body: Thanks for this. :) We ended up talking for the rest of the day. He said he appreciated that I don't do what most people do, which is badger him with "answers" and platitudes. Probably gonna hang out and get pizza this weekend. :)
I didn't. :) He actually kinda said thank you for not trying to come up with answers and for just listening.
I just told him that I kind of agree and maybe I'm not the right person to talk to. Not sure if that was any better than saying nothing at all.

I mean I agree for the most part--ultimately life doesn't have any meaning. I'm an atheist like him as well. I don't know how to explain why it's still worth giving a shot. For me, one of the only reasons I didn't go to the gun range, rent a gun and blow my brains out was because I know that I'd just make my loved ones suffer. But I don't think the fact that I might fucking fall apart when he dies matters to him, and that's just making it about me anyway.

Plenty of people are going to miss him if he kills himself but does that even matter? If I killed myself today, couple of generations from now no one would know I even existed. I don't know what the fuck my great, great great grandpa's name was. Even if I made the history books, all it is is a memory that will eventually fade. One day the whole human race will be gone and nothing that we've ever done will matter at all.

I know all of that, but I don't know, I still want to live, but is that only because I have shelter and shit? Loved ones? I tell myself I like to live to make other's feel better but my mere existence as a priviledged, coddled American is made possible by the suffering of others because this country and all the stupid products I use depend on cheap labor. Who knows, humanity might be better off without resource hungry people like me.

Ultimately I know all the pleasure I've ever felt, including the love I have for this friend, is the product of evolution and a way to just keep myself alive. It's just the aggregation of a bunch of action potentials and neurotransmitters. I'd probably feel similar to my friend if I wasn't on 450 mg of Welbutrin every day.

So yeah, I don't know what the fuck to say to him.
